proposal.reason: The substantive change is a broad redesign of open-source test execution: dual-platform (M890P+810E) workflow orchestration, trusted HPN SDK install handling, platform-aware case generation/grouping, runner device-mapping and diagnostics capture, and expanded xtest definitions/manifests (including patch_omitted case-list data) plus matching CI docs/tests. These are CI workflow/runtime validation changes rather than contribution-policy workflow or PCCL runtime-module behavior changes.
